step1_analysis.description: A cross-coupled CMOS LC oscillator with a direct injection MOS switch across the tank. It functions as a frequency divider by locking to an injection signal at twice its free-running frequency.

paper_reference.title: A CMOS Direct Injection-Locked Oscillator Topology as High-Frequency Low-Power Frequency Divider

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption from the supply.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on standard cross-coupled pair bias currents in 1.8V SKY130.

oscillation_frequency.description: The fundamental frequency of the output signal when locked.

sky130_expected.calculation: Locked to f_inj / 2. With f_inj = 2.24 GHz, f_out = 1.12 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the external LC tank and injection frequency in the testbench.

locking_range.description: The frequency range over which the oscillator remains locked to the input.

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends on injection amplitude and tank Q. Typically 10-20% of f_0.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Direct injection provides wide locking range, scaling with the lower f_0 in this testbench.

output_amplitude.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing of the output node.

sky130_expected.calculation: Limited by VDD and diode-connected load. Swing ~ 0.8V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Cross-coupled pair with diode limiter typically swings a fraction of VDD.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure power, locked oscillation frequency, and output amplitude of the ILFD.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Injection-Locked Frequency Divider Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0
VINX INX 0 DC 0.9 SIN(0.9 0.5 2.24G 0 0)

XM1 Q QX VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 Q INX QX GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 Q QX VSS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 QX Q VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 QX Q VSS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 QX QX Q GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 QX Q QX GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 QX Q QX GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

* LC Tank to set free-running frequency ~1.12 GHz
L1 Q QX 10nH
C1 Q QX 2pF

.ic v(Q)=1.8 v(QX)=0

.control
  tran 10p 20n
  
  * Power consumption
  meas tran pwr_avg avg i(VVDD) from=10n to=20n
  let power = -pwr_avg * 1.8
  print power
  
  * Output frequency
  meas tran t1 trig v(Q) val=0.9 rise=12
  meas tran t2 trig v(Q) val=0.9 rise=13
  let period = t2 - t1
  let freq = 1 / period
  print freq
  
  * Output amplitude
  meas tran vmax max v(Q) from=10n to=20n
  meas tran vmin min v(Q) from=10n to=20n
  let vpp = vmax - vmin
  print vpp
  
  quit
.endc
.end
